decisions.reason: Passenger data transmission builds directly on the firm's core aviation security and border-data expertise, has proven government adoption with over 30 APIS connections, and gives the firm strong interpretable feedback for continued improvement.

The travel health requirements API relates closely to the firm's travel document and passenger-data knowledge base and remains presented on its own page, though its post-pandemic relevance and lack of reported results make it somewhat less secure.

The travel and document verification platform draws on the firm's established document-checking and aviation security competence, so the firm can assimilate market feedback and refine it, justifying retention.
